title: Etale additive Cech coordinates and inverse-image cocycles
statement: Let g:Y→X be a morphism of quasi-compact separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let U,V be finite open covers indexed by the same type, with all intersections indexed by positive-length tuples affine and V-tuples contained in the g-preimages of U-tuples. Let A_Z be the fixed lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], and let mu_Z(r) be an endomorphism whose every section component sends lifted x to lifted x times the structural pullback of r. For each n≥0, there are additive equivalences a:H^n(A_X)→H^n(C(U,O_X)) and aprime:H^n(A_Y)→H^n(C(V,O_Y)), where C denotes cechOver for the unit module and Z.toSpecGamma [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change]. They intertwine mu_Z(r) with multiplication by r on Cech homology. For each etale class x, there are source and target cycles z,zprime whose classes are a(x) and aprime(H(q_g)(g_H^*x)), where q_g is adjoint to structural pullback [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. On every tuple the target cycle coordinate is the source coordinate mapped by unitToPushforwardObjUnit and then restricted along the tuple inclusion. This compares etale cohomology only with section Cech homology; it asserts no ordinary Ext inverse-image identity.

proof.text: Obtain augmentation-normalized additive edge equivalences separately for X and Y. Apply scalar compatibility to each supplied endomorphism family.

Choose a source cycle representing a(x) using ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective for homologyPi. The proved private additiveOrdinaryCechIso and additiveOrdinaryCyclesIso transport ordinary module Cech cycles to explicit abelian Cech cycles; additiveOrdinaryCyclesIso_i identifies their coordinate inclusions. Apply the existing refined-cover cechInverseImageCochainMap with the unitToPushforwardObjUnit coefficient map, apply cyclesMap, and invert the target cycles iso. Naturality of cyclesMap_i and the inverse iso identity give exactly the required target coordinates. This proves existence_additiveOrdinary_cycle_transfer without any new sorry and without an etale cohomology comparison.

Apply normalized inverse-image compatibility to these matched cycles. Substitute homologyPi(z)=a(x) and simplify a.symm(a(x))=x. Assemble the two equivalences, scalar laws, source and target class equalities, and coordinate equality.

proof_origin.place: Cycle representatives transferred through the explicit ordinary cochain map; normalized edge existence, scalar law and inverse-image class law split into three independent statements. No unit route changed.

theorem exists_etaleAdditive_cech_inverseImage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hV : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, V (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) (hcover' : iSup V = ⊤)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (μX : Γ(X, ⊤) → (X.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶ X.etaleAdditiveSheaf))
    (μY : Γ(Y, ⊤) → (Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶ Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf))
    (hμX : ∀ r (W : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : X.etaleAdditiveSheaf.obj.obj W),
      (μX r).hom.app W x =
        ULift.up ((show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from x.down) *
          (show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from W.unop.hom.appTop r)))
    (hμY : ∀ r (W : Y.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf.obj.obj W),
      (μY r).hom.app W x =
        ULift.up ((show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from x.down) *
          (show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from W.unop.hom.appTop r)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : Sheaf.H X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
        (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n,
    ∃ a' : Sheaf.H Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
        (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).homology n,
      (∀ r x, a (Sheaf.H.map (μX r) n x) = r • a x) ∧
      (∀ r x, a' (Sheaf.H.map (μY r) n x) = r • a' x) ∧
      ∀ x,
        ∃ z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n,
        ∃ z' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n,
          (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z =
            a x ∧
          (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z' =
            a' (Sheaf.H.map
              (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction _ g).homEquiv _ _).symm
                (Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g)) n
              (Etale.cohomologyMap g X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n x)) ∧
          ∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
            cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y
                ((cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') =
              (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
                ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
                  (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
                  (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y
                    ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
                      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z)))
